description.text:
We are seeking a Technical UI/UX Designer to act as the connective layer between the UX/UI Department and Frontend Development. This is primarily a technical role: the ideal candidate is deeply fluent in Figma at a component/systems level and comfortable discussing implementation details with developers.
Rather than leading new visual concepts, this role owns the technical integrity of the Design System in Figma, supports developers when design-related implementation issues arise, and establishes clear workflows for tracking and resolving those issues.
#Responsibilities
1. Act as the primary connection point between the UX/UI Department and Frontend Developers.
2. Build and maintain components in Figma for the company Design System.
3. Serve as the first line of support for handling issues and questions related to designs.
4. Collect and consolidate implementation feedback from developers in Taipei.
5. Discuss implementation challenges directly with the Tbilisi team.
6. Establish and maintain workflows for reporting and tracking implementation issues using Jira.
7. Ensure proper versioning of designs using named checkpoints in Figma.
8. Review design handoffs for technical feasibility before they reach development.
9. Keep Design System documentation accurate and up to date as components evolve.
#Requirements
1. 2+ years of experience working with Figma, including developing and maintaining components.
2. Strong technical Figma skills (component architecture, variants, auto-layout, design tokens, versioning/checkpoints).
3. Solid understanding of frontend development concepts and constraints (HTML/CSS fundamentals; ability to speak the language of developers).
4. Experience working with Jira, including setting up or following issue-tracking workflows.
5. Experience in the iGaming industry is a plus.
6. Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
7. Must be able to communicate fluently in English.
